title: Ongoing Management
meta: A first month of eBay seller care: listing upkeep, orders, offers and a report. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: eBay ongoing management, started the right way
overview: Steady care keeps an eBay account healthy. We review your account, agree a task list, and complete the first round inside the sprint: listing refreshes, order and tracking checks, buyer messages, offer handling and a short report. You get a weekly calendar and a written summary. If it fits, a monthly plan is quoted separately, based on what your account really needed.

pkgs.blurb: A care plan for your account and the first tasks done.
A first month of care with updates along the way.
A full month of care and a three-month plan for the account.

faq: Small repeat jobs such as revising a title, answering a buyer, relisting an ended item, uploading tracking, accepting or declining an offer under your rules, or checking a stock count. Bigger projects are quoted separately.
No, it is a fixed starter sprint. Afterward we tell you what the account needed, and quote a monthly plan if you want one, built on tasks you have already seen done.
How do you protect my seller level?
By shipping and replying on time, and by never using risky shortcuts. We do not do anything that breaks eBay's rules, such as feedback swaps, off-site sales or selling limit workarounds.
You. Everything happens inside your eBay account with the access you grant, and we send a summary of changes. You can remove our access whenever you like.
